name: TD Sequential nine-count setup
note: Counts consecutive bars closing on the wrong side of the close four bars earlier -- no average, no band, no ratio -- and enters when the run reaches nine AND the geometric perfection condition holds on the lows of the last two setup bars against bars six and seven. Exits on the mirrored count. Purely ordinal, exactly as published.
